title: Provisioning and device identity

spans.text: LESSON PURPOSE

Goal: apply “Provisioning and device identity” to a real program or device. The key principle is: Per-device identities help limit the impact of a credential leak. In a project, follow this guidance: Never ship every device with the same default password.

CORE EXPLANATION
Provisioning is the initial setup for connecting a device to a network and service. Give each device a unique identity, keep an inventory, and plan revocation for lost devices.
